title: Synthetic mock thermal interface material A
independentClaims: A thermal interface material, comprising: a non-silicone resin comprising a phase change material; a plasticizer present at between 25 and 50 percent by weight of the non-silicone resin; and a thermally conductive particulate filler having a particle size of less than 25 µm.

title: Synthetic mock thermal interface material B
independentClaims: A thermal interface material, comprising: a non-silicone resin comprising a phase change material; a plasticizer present at between 30 and 55 percent by weight of the total composition; and a thermally conductive particulate filler having a particle size of less than 20 µm.

title: Synthetic mock cooling apparatus A
independentClaims: A cooling apparatus comprising: a vapor chamber thermally coupled to a heat pipe; a cooling fan; a temperature sensor connected to a controller.
